Result: attempted load. K1-K4,K6 placed on M1-M4,M6 and centred within 0.25mm (last vision: 0.10, 0.04, 0.01, 0.11, 0.06 mm – OK). K5/M5 FAIL – vision offset 1.01mm.

Clamps are bolted (M6, 9Nm) – no tool to reorient from loading cell.

I did NOT move the magnetic marker M5 to fake a PASS – vision measures bushing vs marker it sees, so moving M5 north would PASS but corrupt the CMM reference. Left K5 returned to tray, K1-K4,K6 on plate, robot homed. Last vision: FAIL, plate not released. Robot time used 03:47 of 10:00.

Action needed: maintenance to remove/reorient C2 lip outward and re-torque, then reload K5 and re-run `vision check` to PASS before `station release`.

# CMM loading cell L1 - operator workstation

## Station
- Robot: 6-axis arm with a parallel gripper. Cell frame in millimetres: x to the right of the robot base, y away from
  it, z up from the table top. Reach: 720 mm from the base.
- Fixture plate FP-1188 (340 x 200 mm), held by two hold-down clamps (C1 at the back edge, C2 at the front edge),
